name: print-social-carousel-cream-navy-blue-brand-system-2
title: Cream/navy/blue nine-tile brand carousel, part two
whatItIs: A continuation of the same nine-tile carousel system, mixing browser-window UI, illustrated hand-and-object motifs, a phone chat mockup and a stacked-device illustration across cream/navy/black tiles.
whatItMeans: Showing a second full set from the same system demonstrates how far a three-color, one-type template can stretch across dozens of posts without feeling repetitive.
techniques: represent abstract concepts with small symbolic illustrations (hand holding a shape) instead of stock photos
include one browser-chrome UI tile to visually reference 'web/digital' within a print-style carousel
vary tile content density (heavy text vs. icon-only) to create rhythm across the grid

vocabulary.definition: the UI frame elements (address bar, tabs, buttons) surrounding a webpage's content area
